# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 batch 13 reg-albania1, Albania and Skanderbeg, phase 1. Generated by gen_albania.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES id 35: a hook); this line writes
# no monthly hook of its own. Order (design 4.1): open, close (1480.1.1); the check of last month's land steps, the world
# steps, at most one event, the notice .91, then January.
oe_alb_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_live } } set_global_variable = oe_alb_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_on } } set_variable = oe_alb_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1480.1.1 }
            set_variable = oe_alb_off
            debug_log = "oe_alb: the line is closed (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_ws')|0])"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1384.1.1 }
            oe_alb_check = yes
            oe_alb_world = yes
            oe_alb_events = yes
            if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_alb_january = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The land steps are checked again the month after they ran (design 4.1): 1 still so, 5 not any more.
oe_alb_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_2 ?= 9 }
        if = { limit = { location:durres = { owner ?= c:VEN } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_2 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_2 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_3 ?= 9 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_lezha ?= 1 } location:lezha = { owner ?= c:VEN } }
                OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_shkoder ?= 1 } location:shkoder = { owner ?= c:VEN } }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_3 value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_3 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_4 ?= 9 }
        if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_s_avlonya ?= 1 } location:avlonya = { owner ?= c:TUR } } OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_s_berat ?= 1 } location:berat = { owner ?= c:TUR } } OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_s_ballsh ?= 1 } location:ballsh = { owner ?= c:TUR } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_4 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_4 value = 5 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps (design 4.2): in its window each step is skipped (3) when a player or the empire's bloc is
# concerned; else it runs with its chance when it can run and what it waits for has come; after the window, 2.
# phase 2: W5-W8 (1432-1450); phase 3: W9-W12 (1455-1479).
oe_alb_world = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_1 } var:oe_alb_m >= 582 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 588 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_1 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w1_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_1 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_wch_1 oe_alb_w1_run = yes } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_2 } var:oe_alb_m >= 654 }
        if = { limit = { oe_alb_w2_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 3 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_alb_c2 ?= 3 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 816 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 2 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_durres value = 3 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m >= 781 oe_alb_w2_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_wch_2l oe_alb_w2_run = yes } }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 672 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_w2_now oe_alb_w2_ok = yes } oe_alb_w2_run = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w2_ok = yes oe_alb_e2_open = no } random = { chance = oe_alb_wch_2 oe_alb_w2_run = yes } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_3 } var:oe_alb_m >= 673 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 720 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_3 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w3_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_3 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w3_ok = yes oe_alb_w3_wait = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_wch_3 oe_alb_w3_run = yes } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_4 } var:oe_alb_m >= 937 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 996 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_4 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w4_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_4 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w4_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_wch_4 oe_alb_w4_run = yes } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. W1 Savra (1385.6-1385.12). Every Albanian lord (oe_alb_lord) gets the tribute of Savra for 20 years and +20
# opinion of the Ottomans; Zeta, if AI and outside the bloc, loses prestige and hands Durazzo to the Thopia where it holds
# it in hand and the Thopia are AI and outside the bloc. No subject relation (design 七.2). BYZ var oe_alb_savra_m: the month.
oe_alb_w1 = {
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_alb_lord = yes }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_savra_tribute years = 20 mode = replace }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_savra target = c:TUR } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ZTA c:ZTA = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        c:ZTA = { add_prestige = -10 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                country_exists = c:THP c:THP = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
                location:durres = { owner ?= c:ZTA controller ?= c:ZTA has_siege = no is_capital = no }
            }
            location:durres = { change_location_owner = c:THP change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } }
            if = { limit = { location:durres = { owner ?= c:THP } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_savra_dur value = 1 } }
        }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_savra_m value = var:oe_alb_m }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_v_lords > 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_1 value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_1 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W2 Venetian Durazzo. The owner is paid 3 months of its own income, both gain opinion, Durazzo passes to Venice.
# Self-check: Venice holds Durazzo -> 1 (oe_alb_durres = 1, the check next month), else 5.
oe_alb_w2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w2_ok = yes }
        location:durres = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                scope:oe_alb_giver = { add_gold = oe_alb_v_annuity add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_ven_deal target = c:VEN } }
                c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_ven_deal target = scope:oe_alb_giver } }
                change_location_owner = c:VEN change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:durres = { owner ?= c:VEN } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_durres value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_2 value = 9 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W3 Lezhë and Scutari. Lezhë to Venice where it qualifies; Scutari where Zeta or a lord seated in Zeta holds it,
# its owner paid as in W2. Self-check: at least one moved -> 1, else 5.
oe_alb_w3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_ven_ok = yes oe_alb_w3_lezha = yes }
        location:lezha = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                change_location_owner = c:VEN change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:lezha = { owner ?= c:VEN } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_lezha value = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_ven_ok = yes oe_alb_w3_shkoder = yes }
        location:shkoder = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                scope:oe_alb_giver = { add_gold = oe_alb_v_annuity add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_ven_deal target = c:VEN } }
                c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_ven_deal target = scope:oe_alb_giver } }
                change_location_owner = c:VEN change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:shkoder = { owner ?= c:VEN } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_shkoder value = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_alb_lezha ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_shkoder ?= 1 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_3 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_3 value = 9 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_3 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W4 the south. Each of avlonya, berat, ballsh that qualifies passes to the Ottomans (global oe_alb_s_<place> = 1);
# oe_alb_south counts them. Self-check: at least one -> 1, else 5.
oe_alb_w4 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_south value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w4_loc = { loc = avlonya } }
        location:avlonya = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:avlonya = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_s_avlonya value = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_south add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w4_loc = { loc = berat } }
        location:berat = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:berat = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_s_berat value = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_south add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w4_loc = { loc = ballsh } }
        location:ballsh = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:ballsh = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_s_ballsh value = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_south add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_south ?= 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_4 value = 5 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_4 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_4 value = 9 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events (design 4.4): lapse; at most one event (lock, calm, 6 months since the last); the notice .91.
oe_alb_events = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_c12_m } OR = { var:oe_col_c12 ?= 1 var:oe_col_c12 ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c12_m value = var:oe_alb_m } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_1 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_2 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_3 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_3 value = 2 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 2 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 3 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 1 } oe_alb_send_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 2 } oe_alb_send_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 3 } oe_alb_send_3 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_alb_pick
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_ok_91 = yes } oe_alb_send_91 = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of each event: its state (st 1), the gap, and the event. The monthly check and the test buttons
# both use it, so a button shows the event exactly as the month would (the sums in the text are read when shown).
oe_alb_send_1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_last value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_gap months = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_alb.1 }
oe_alb_send_2 = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_last value = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_gap months = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_alb.2 }
oe_alb_send_3 = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_3 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_last value = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_gap months = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_alb.3 }
oe_alb_send_91 = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_91 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_alb.91 }

# BYZ scope, January. .3 b: the wages of the Arcadian horse, one month of income a year while years are left.
oe_alb_january = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_pay_left var:oe_alb_pay_left > 0 }
        oe_alb_pay = { months = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_alb_pay_left add = -1 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month; never below 10 gold a month).
oe_alb_pay = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = -$months$ } }

# BYZ scope. The worker oe_alb.90: every option of the line sets oe_alb_do and wakes it (no work in an option preview).
oe_alb_work = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 11 } oe_alb_job_11 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 12 } oe_alb_job_12 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 13 } oe_alb_job_13 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 21 } oe_alb_job_21 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 22 } oe_alb_job_22 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 23 } oe_alb_job_23 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 31 } oe_alb_job_31 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 32 } oe_alb_job_32 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 33 } oe_alb_job_33 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_alb_do
}
# 11: .1 a, envoys to the lords.
oe_alb_job_11 = {
    oe_alb_pay = { months = 0.5 }
    every_country = { limit = { oe_alb_lord = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_envoys target = c:BYZ } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_envoys_tur target = c:BYZ } } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c1 value = 1 }
}
# 12: .1 b, congratulations to the sultan.
oe_alb_job_12 = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_congrats target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_stage country_exists = c:TUR is_subject_of = c:TUR } oe_vas_add_patience = { amount = 5 } }
    every_country = { limit = { oe_alb_lord = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_snub target = c:BYZ } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c1 value = 2 }
}
# 13: .1 c, no heed.
oe_alb_job_13 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c1 value = 3 }
}
# 21: .2 a, Durazzo bought in peace.
oe_alb_job_21 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_ev_2 = yes oe_alb_can_pay = { months = 6 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_price value = oe_alb_v_m6 }
        location:durres = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver } }
        oe_alb_pay = { months = 6 }
        scope:oe_alb_giver = { add_gold = root.var:oe_alb_price }
        location:durres = { change_location_owner = c:BYZ }
        remove_variable = oe_alb_price
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_durres_bought target = c:BYZ } } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven >= 2 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_durres_bought_x target = c:BYZ } } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_durres value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_fail value = 0 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_fail value = 21 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c2 value = 1 }
}
# 22: .2 b, Durazzo left to Venice.
oe_alb_job_22 = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_durres_left target = c:BYZ } } }
    set_global_variable = oe_alb_w2_now
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c2 value = 2 }
}
# 23: .2 c, Durazzo urged to hold.
oe_alb_job_23 = {
    oe_alb_pay = { months = 1 }
    location:durres = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_grateful target = c:BYZ } } } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c2 value = 3 }
}
# 31: .3 a, land for service in Arcadia.
oe_alb_job_31 = {
    var:oe_col_mor_1 ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_stratiotai years = 30 mode = replace } } } var:oe_col_mor_2 ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_stratiotai years = 30 mode = replace } } } var:oe_col_mor_3 ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_stratiotai years = 30 mode = replace } } }
    oe_mo_theme_loy = { amount = 5 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c3 value = 1 }
}
# 32: .3 b, wages for the Arcadian horse.
oe_alb_job_32 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pay_left value = 10 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c3 value = 2 }
}
# 33: .3 c, the chiefs refused.
oe_alb_job_33 = {
    var:oe_col_mor_1 ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_highland_unrest years = 10 mode = replace } } } var:oe_col_mor_2 ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_highland_unrest years = 10 mode = replace } } } var:oe_col_mor_3 ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_highland_unrest years = 10 mode = replace } } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c3 value = 3 }
}

# ---- readout and test effects (the test page, prefix alb; never called from an option or the month)
# Any scope. One debug-log line with the line's state (alblog).
oe_alb_log = {
    debug_log = "oe_alb m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_m')|0] ws=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_ws')|0] chk=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_chk')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_st')|0] c=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_c')|0] flags=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_flags')|0] savm=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_savm')|0] savdur=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_savdur')|0] lords=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_lords')|0] durres=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_durres')|0] lezha=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_lezha')|0] shkoder=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_shkoder')|0] south=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_south')|0] c12m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_c12m')|0] payleft=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_payleft')|0] fail=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_fail')|0] own=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_own')|0] (durres/lezha/shkoder/avlonya/berat/ballsh/kruje: 1 BYZ 2 VEN 3 TUR 4 bloc 5 free AI 6 player) durres=[GetLocationByKey('durres').GetOwner.GetName] lezha=[GetLocationByKey('lezha').GetOwner.GetName] shkoder=[GetLocationByKey('shkoder').GetOwner.GetName]"
}
# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The assimilation readout (albassim; design 1.5): the first maker's counts, and the place the
# start rule of oe_rw_start_albania_romanization would pick now (the same order: Durazzo +1000000, the empire's own
# +100000000, then population) with its share of Albanians. Writes only this line's readout variables.
oe_alb_test_assim = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_as_loc } remove_variable = oe_alb_as_loc }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_pct value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_byz value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_albania_romanization_started } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_byz value = 1 } }
    ordered_ownable_location = {
        limit = { oe_rw_assim_albania_location = yes is_ownable = yes has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } "culture_percentage(culture:albanian)" >= 0.5 }
        max = 1
        order_by = {
            value = population
            if = { limit = { this = location:durres } add = 1000000 }
            if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } add = 100000000 }
        }
        save_scope_as = oe_alb_as_top
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_alb_as_top }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_loc value = scope:oe_alb_as_top }
        scope:oe_alb_as_top = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_pct value = oe_alb_v_albpct } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_pct value = scope:oe_alb_as_top.var:oe_alb_as_pct }
        scope:oe_alb_as_top = { remove_variable = oe_alb_as_pct }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_alb assimilation: owned [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_rw_assim_albania_owned')|0] of [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_rw_assim_albania_total')|0], needed [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_rw_assim_albania_required')|0]; started [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_asbyz')|0] (1 the movement was started); the start rule's first place [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_alb_as_loc').GetLocation.GetName] with [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_aspct')|0]% Albanians (0 and no name: no place qualifies)"
}
# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The events at once through their senders (no date, chance, lock, calm or gap; the event's own
# trigger is still checked).
oe_alb_test_e1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_ev_1 = yes } oe_alb_send_1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_alb test: .1 cannot be shown (the City is not the empire's)" }
}
oe_alb_test_e2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_ev_2 = yes } oe_alb_send_2 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_alb test: .2 cannot be shown (Durazzo must be held in hand by a free AI owner at peace with the empire, and the bloc must hold land in Albania or northern Greece)" }
}
oe_alb_test_e3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_ev_3 = yes } oe_alb_send_3 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_alb test: .3 cannot be shown (oe_col.12 must have been answered a or b (col2ev12 first), and one of its places in Arcadia must still be the bloc's)" }
}
# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. A world step now, the window, the chance and the waits aside (its record is overwritten); its
# condition oe_alb_w<n>_ok is still checked, except W1's Ottoman land in the Balkans (none in a 1337 game).
oe_alb_test_w1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_tur_ok = yes oe_alb_w1_lords = yes } oe_alb_w1_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_alb test: W1 cannot run (the Ottomans must be AI and outside the empire's side, and two free AI countries must hold land in the Albanian area; the Ottoman land in the Balkans is not asked here)" }
}
oe_alb_test_w2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_w2_ok = yes } oe_alb_w2_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_alb test: W2 cannot run (Venice must be AI and outside the empire's side; Durazzo held in hand by a free AI owner at peace with Venice, not a capital unless its last place)" }
}
oe_alb_test_w3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_w3_ok = yes } oe_alb_w3_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_alb test: W3 cannot run (Venice must be AI and outside the empire's side; Lezha, or Scutari of Zeta or a lord seated in Zeta, held in hand by a free AI owner at peace with Venice)" }
}
oe_alb_test_w4 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_w4_ok = yes } oe_alb_w4_run = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_alb test: W4 cannot run (the Ottomans must be AI and outside the empire's side; Avlona, Berat or Ballsh held in hand by a free AI owner at peace with them that borders them or bears the tribute of Savra)" }
}
# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Every variable of the line goes (modifiers and land stay as they are).
oe_alb_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_on } remove_variable = oe_alb_on }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_off } remove_variable = oe_alb_off }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_m } remove_variable = oe_alb_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_pick } remove_variable = oe_alb_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } remove_variable = oe_alb_gap }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_do } remove_variable = oe_alb_do }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_fail } remove_variable = oe_alb_fail }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_savra_m } remove_variable = oe_alb_savra_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_c12_m } remove_variable = oe_alb_c12_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_pay_left } remove_variable = oe_alb_pay_left }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_price } remove_variable = oe_alb_price }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_as_loc } remove_variable = oe_alb_as_loc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_as_pct } remove_variable = oe_alb_as_pct }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_as_byz } remove_variable = oe_alb_as_byz }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_last } remove_variable = oe_alb_last }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_st_1 } remove_variable = oe_alb_st_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_st_2 } remove_variable = oe_alb_st_2 }

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_c1 } remove_variable = oe_alb_c1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_c2 } remove_variable = oe_alb_c2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_c3 } remove_variable = oe_alb_c3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_live } remove_global_variable = oe_alb_live }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_durres } remove_global_variable = oe_alb_durres }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_lezha } remove_global_variable = oe_alb_lezha }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_shkoder } remove_global_variable = oe_alb_shkoder }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_south } remove_global_variable = oe_alb_south }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_savra_dur } remove_global_variable = oe_alb_savra_dur }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_w2_now } remove_global_variable = oe_alb_w2_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_1 } remove_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_1 }
